column1: # Actions must be defined before the alarm configurations that list them in AlarmActions (several separated by ;).
# Trigger defines at which change of the alarm the action is sent:
#   Trigger=Raise      Sent when the alarm is raised: the condition of the alarm configuration
#   Trigger=Normalize  Sent when the alarm is normalized: the condition became false again (e.g. CommunicationError = 0)
#                      or the alarm configuration was disabled or removed (configuration reload).
# Each alarm occurrence sends its Raise actions once and its Normalize actions once
# An alarm configuration can list any number of actions
